units: <cite ref="Zevachim 88b:7">Zeb. 88ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ מכפר וכ׳</he> the Highpriest’s breast-plate brings atonement for wrong judgments.
<cite ref="Shabbat 139a:14">Sabb. 139ᵃ</cite> <he>זכה לח׳ המשפט וכ׳</he> was privileged to wear the breast-plate of judgment upon his heart.
Yoma 72ᵃ המזיח ח׳ מעל וכ׳ he who loosens the breast-plate from the Ephod; a. fr.
